name: batch_deploy
description:
Deploy an app to multiple tracks in a single operation.

This is useful for deploying to internal and alpha tracks simultaneously,
or for promoting to multiple testing tracks at once.

file_path.description: Absolute path to APK or AAB file

release_notes.description: Optional release notes for all tracks

rollout_percentages.description: Optional dict mapping track names to rollout percentages

tracks.description: List of tracks to deploy to (e.g., ["internal", "alpha"])
